subject: Render delta READY: specialized variants + real n2mb_draw_v2 commits; CPU layer slices PASS
body:
Implemented current delta; no heavy build/phone/commit. Changed production: render_pipeline.inc, render_encoder.inc, compositor_submit.inc, device_limits.h; test helper gpu/tests/iosurface_cpu_test.py extracts the new real CPU-layer helper.

SPECIALIZED PATH
- prepare stores VS/FS SPIR-V + fetch; draw calls plan_generic_specialized then a pipeline-owned immutable variant cache.
- Compiles via compile_generic_pair_specialized/_rt/_tile_rt with independent VS/FS tables; never falls back to unspecialized when constants change.
- Cache key includes module bytes, rt/mainRT/color/tile mode, both stage tables, and the full 3360B sidecar (512-byte planner key). Host assertions prove 512-key and per-stage-constant changes alter the key.
- Dispatch selects by 1-based index in renderArgs[0]; compositor_submit uses that shader. Queued nearest/linear/nearest jobs after early app release commit successfully; default-equivalent nearest variant is asserted byte-equal to default code.

V2 TRANSPORT
- Current n2mb_draw_v2 is called directly for v2-required draws. Host test commits a 2-level BGRA8 texture with exact linear sampler through the real bridge + fake JM (status4), and queued mip jobs after app release (status4).
- Sidecar consumes selected plan exact Metal view format/compare; aliased view formats force v2. Nonzero view level/layer, twin/swizzle flags and immutable v2 still refuse explicitly.
- 2-level mip frontend now plans/submits; ASTC 204 stops at translator format-feature refusal (explicit, no neutral).

CPU
- getBytes/replaceRegion address every 2D-array/cube/cube-array/MS-array slice; 3D depth unchanged; MS is sample0 of selected layer. Host verifies 3 array layers, 6 cube faces, 2 MS-array slices; iosurface_cpu_test PASS.

EVIDENCE
- host_test_vs_texture.py PASS in two binaries: stub variant selection and real bridge. Current compute cdylib 8861e0a0..., Mesa ec828d0f..., synced air_bridge.h eea1de13... .
- ARM64 production frontend -Wall -Wextra -Werror syntax PASS; diffcheck clean.
- render hashes: encoder 6b1277a6..., pipeline cf3e8d05..., submit ecd96c7a..., limits 4427b724... .

REMAINING EXPLICIT
- immutable GenericBinding lacks exact Metal LOD/normalized/bias/integer state.
- translator still refuses ASTC sampled format; render facts/sidecar are ready.
- specialized planner admission for cube/cube-array/MS sampling beyond 2D/mip/2D-array; render CPU/layout/sidecar paths exist.
- view_type/aspect synced but not yet validated by render; nonzero view level/layer/twin/swizzle refuse.
- MRT _rt/tile variants compile in code but lack a real frontend host fixture.
- vertexStart+VertexIndex refusal stays per instruction.
No hardware claim.
